PR Summary by Qodo

Document the approved v1 pipeline design and build state 📝 Documentation ⚙️ Configuration changes 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Establish the approved v1 design as the source of truth for the pipeline build.
>• Record milestones, platform-check results, and pre-approved fallbacks so future sessions can
>  resume.
>• Ignore local worktrees and Python cache files.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD Architect["Architect"] --> State[("State branch")] --> Lead["Mission lead"] --> Builders["Builders"] --> Reviews["Reviews"] --> Gate["Merge gate"] --> Main[("Project main")] Lead --> Room["Phase room"] --> Architect ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keeping the approved design and resumable build state in separate versioned documents is appropriate: one defines the intended protocol, while the other records findings that may change its implementation. Before building from them, reconcile the design's statements that builders push task branches with BUILD-STATE.md's later decision that builders never push.
Files changed (3) +465 / -0

Documentation (2) +463 / -0
BUILD-STATE.mdRecord milestones, platform checks, and build decisions +66/-0
>Record milestones, platform checks, and build decisions > >
>• Adds a session-resumption record with milestone status, pre-approved fallbacks, and results or pending probes for eleven platform assumptions. Documents findings about branch deletion, private-repository protection, and empty repositories, including the decision to keep builder branches local.
>
> >docs/design/BUILD-STATE.md
v1.mdEstablish the approved v1 pipeline design +397/-0
>Establish the approved v1 pipeline design > >
>• Defines roles, state ownership, mission lifecycle, reviews, merge safeguards, lead rotation, security boundaries, and release procedures. Also specifies platform assumptions, failure drills, and the planned build sequence.
>
> >docs/design/v1.md

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
